::: {#exm-device}

#### Where the digits live

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
has_gpu = torch.cuda.is_available()
print(images.device, has_gpu)
```

`images` was made without naming a [device](#def-device),
so it lives on the `r toupper(py$images$device$type)`.
`torch.cuda.is_available()` says whether this computer has an NVIDIA GPU that PyTorch can use;
it returned `` `r if (py$has_gpu) "True" else "False"` `` on the computer that built this page.
Where it returns `True`, `images.to("cuda")` makes a copy of `images` on the GPU.

:::
